TEMPORARY / FOREVER

Serve this folder over HTTP, then open the displayed URL in a WebGL2 browser:
  python3 -m http.server 8080
  http://localhost:8080/

Click ENTER THE WORK ZONE once. The demo plays through automatically.
F: fullscreen. Esc or click: exit. Choose Economy on a slower machine.
All assets are packaged here. No external service is needed.
